pages.title: Riding & Abilities

pages.text: Change any key in $(l)Options > Controls > Key Binds$(). The search bar there helps.$(br2)$(l)Reset All$() brings back the server's recommended keys. Do this after big pack updates.
pages.title: Changing Keys

pages.text: Shaders add real shadows, sky and water. Turn them on in $(l)Options > Video Settings > Shader Packs$().$(br2)$(l)Complementary$() looks the best; $(l)MakeUp$() and $(l)Super Duper Vanilla$() are lighter for slower computers. $(l)F7$() toggles them.
pages.title: Shaders
